source: The comments are extremely divided and users on both sides cited articles to defend their positions.
claim: 156 of the Reddit comments advocate sleep training, 126 oppose it, and 43 take no position.

source: There were articles from reporters pushing their opinion on both sides of the debate, many with incredibly dramatic titles.
claim: 94 of the articles advocate sleep training, 27 oppose it, and 19 take no position.

source: and again the results were divided.
claim: 24 of the books advocate sleep training and 12 oppose it.

source: the majority of published pediatric sleep researchers advocate sleep training.
claim: 74 of the 75 clinical studies are categorized as advocating sleep training.

source: If we plot each clinical study according to year of publication, we see that indeed most occurred within the past 40 years.
claim: 71 of the 75 clinical studies were published in 1984 or later.
